label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.75… supports Every operation has an agent whose…
note: ST I q.75 a.2 co. states that operating belongs only to a being in act and that a thing operates in the way it is: operation is always some being's operating. The premise states that every operation has an agent whose operation it is; the passage presupposes an operating subject for each operation rather than stating it as a principle over operations as items.
